C-19.Name: Heading navigation: Go-to-Heading palette (Cmd+T) + active-heading highlight in the TOC (matrix P1)
C-19.IntentSummary: Give long agent documents VS Code-grade heading navigation: a Go-to-Heading palette command (Cmd+T, native Edit-menu entry) fuzzy over the active document's listToc jumping via the established slugs, and a sidebar TOC that highlights the section the viewport is in (debounced scrollspy with a document-end edge so the final section is reachable); no title-bar geometry changes (breadcrumbs are a separate follow-up).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: commands/headingSearch.js (fuzzy subsequence over listToc, level-indented labels, slug jump via scroll-to-header); static registry twin (dynamic-import execute avoids the store↔registry cycle); barrel export; descriptions map + nested i18n keys; native Edit-menu "Go to Heading…" with CmdOrCtrl+T pinned by menu-consistency.

editor.vue emits toc-active-heading (200ms debounce off muya scroll; last heading above a fixed 80px band from the viewport top; document-end edge pins the final heading); toc.vue renders the highlight through its scoped slot (.toc-node-label--active — el-tree's is-current paths leave stale nodes in this Element Plus version) and clears on null.

V-M-011 scenario-31 + commands (incl. the new unit and e2e files); grace lint zero findings on changed files; full vitest green (isolated worktree) incl. CI-mode thresholds; full e2e green; two sequential reviews clean.

Verification.Command: npm run test:coverage; npx playwright test; grace lint --path . --assertions current

Review-1.Angle: correctness (scrollspy edge cases, debounce lifecycle, fuzzy matcher false positives, palette interplay with quick-open)

Review-2.Angle: security (no new surface), GRACE contract/graph/verification consistency, regression risk to the palette/TOC

Evidence.Gates: Unit: heading-search 6/6 (re-pinned for the run/execute contract), menu-consistency 12/12 incl. the C-19 id/accelerator/uniqueness pin; cargo check green after the menu entry. E2e: heading-navigation 2/2 — palette gate drives the REAL cmd::execute route (twin constructs the command, palette lists every heading, typing+Enter lands Beta in view) and the TOC scrollspy gate follows Alpha → Beta → Top with exactly one active node (paragraph fillers; document-end edge exercised at Beta).
Evidence.Coverage: headingSearch fully table-driven; scrollspy edge covered by the e2e waypoints (mid-doc, doc-end, top).
Evidence.Reviews: Review-1 (correctness/edge-cases): NEEDS-FIXES round-1 — 1 BLOCKER (run() emitted show-command-palette → synchronous recursion through the palette's handleShow; also opened with an empty list), 1 MAJOR (scrollspy pinned the LAST heading when no heading is above the band — front-matter/preamble docs), 1 MAJOR (palette e2e missing), 2 MINOR (change-handler cleared the scrollspy timer without re-arming; unmount asymmetry), NITs (dead SPECIAL_CHARS/treeRef, undefined theme var, pin uniqueness, summary order). Review-2 (security/ contracts): same BLOCKER + MAJOR (governance claimed the missing e2e), MINORs (indent invisible — HTML space collapsing; scope/ wording drift; toc.vue summary overstatement). ALL FIXED in-session: run() populates subcommands / execute() emits after delay(100) (sibling contract — unit test re-pinned); scrollspy emits null above the first heading and pins the last only at the document end; real-path palette e2e added (cmd::execute → twin → palette lists headings → typing+Enter lands the target in view); timer re-armed on content change and cleared on unmount; nbsp level-indent; scoped-slot cleanup + defined theme var; pin uniqueness assertion; summaries/order/scope synced; 80px-band wording everywhere. Security verified clean (interpolation-escaped labels, muya-key slugs only, no new surface).
